summary_en: This Phase I/Ib study evaluates the safety and efficacy of targeted therapies or immunotherapy, alone or in combination, in adults with metastatic colorectal cancer whose tumors are biomarker positive. Study drugs are given by mouth or by intravenous (IV) infusion, and dosing schedules are set for each arm, such as divarasib by mouth once daily on Days 1-28 of 28-day cycles. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase I/Ib.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I/Ib evalúa la seguridad y la eficacia de terapias dirigidas o de inmunoterapia, solas o combinadas, en adultos con cáncer colorrectal metastásico cuyos tumores son positivos para un biomarcador. Los medicamentos del estudio se administran por vía oral o por infusión intravenosa (IV), y los esquemas de dosis se definen para cada brazo, como divarasib por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 28 de ciclos de 28 días. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase I/Ib.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who signed the cohort-specific consent form.
Metastatic colon or rectal adenocarcinoma with at least one measurable tumor.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less.
Tumor biomarker result confirmed by a validated test, as defined for each arm.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months, per the investigator.
not_for: Currently enrolled in another interventional clinical trial (follow-up periods of other trials are allowed).
Systemic anti-cancer treatment within 2 weeks or 5 half-lives before study treatment, whichever is shorter.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
Symptomatic, untreated, or actively growing brain metastases.
Cancer other than colorectal cancer within 2 years before screening, with some exceptions.
